evals.prompt: I'm getting ECONNREFUSED 127.0.0.1:5432 when connecting to PostgreSQL from my Node.js app. Research current causes and fixes, including Docker-related issues.
evals.expected_output: Parallel 9router-first research with inline citations covering multiple causes, actionable fixes, and research coverage showing subagent lanes.

assertions.name: has-inline-citations
assertions.description: Output contains inline source citations in (source: URL) format

assertions.name: mentions-parallel-lanes
assertions.description: Output includes research coverage or lane information from parallel subagents

assertions.name: mentions-9router-tooling
assertions.description: Output is transparent that 9router/ninerouter tooling was used or that fallback occurred

assertions.name: covers-multiple-causes
assertions.description: Output covers at least 3 distinct causes of ECONNREFUSED
assertions.criteria: The output identifies at least 3 distinct root causes such as PostgreSQL not running, wrong host/port, Docker/container networking issues, firewall rules, listen_addresses, or pg_hba.conf/access configuration.

assertions.name: includes-actionable-fix
assertions.description: Output includes at least one concrete command or config change
assertions.criteria: The output includes concrete actionable fixes such as pg_isready, systemctl/pg_ctl commands, Docker host changes, connection string updates, or PostgreSQL config changes.

evals.prompt: Using 9router in Pi, research whether Next.js partial prerendering is stable enough for a production dashboard in 2026, or whether we should wait.
evals.expected_output: 9router-first current research with official/recent/community lanes, inline citations, and a recommendation that reflects latest Next.js status.

assertions.name: has-inline-citations
assertions.description: Output contains inline source citations in (source: URL) format

assertions.name: reflects-current-context
assertions.description: Output addresses current/stability context rather than only generic background
assertions.criteria: The output discusses the current maturity/stability of Next.js partial prerendering with version, release, documentation, or recent community context.

assertions.name: has-recommendation
assertions.description: Output gives a clear wait/adopt/conditional recommendation
assertions.criteria: The output includes a recommendation such as adopt for limited cases, wait, or proceed conditionally, with tradeoffs and caveats.

assertions.name: shows-research-coverage
assertions.description: Output includes research coverage, lanes, or source-type transparency

evals.prompt: Compare Temporal vs BullMQ for a Node.js microservices platform. I care about operational overhead, durability, learning curve, and what teams report in production.
evals.expected_output: Parallel comparative research with official, community, and comparison lanes; inline citations; decision framework; and gaps/conflicts.

assertions.name: has-inline-citations
assertions.description: Output contains inline source citations in (source: URL) format

assertions.name: covers-both-tools
assertions.description: Output covers both Temporal and BullMQ with meaningful detail
assertions.criteria: The output discusses Temporal and BullMQ specifically, including real differences rather than generic queue advice.

assertions.name: covers-tradeoff-dimensions
assertions.criteria: The output covers operational overhead, durability/reliability, learning curve, and production/team experience or community reports.

assertions.name: has-decision-framework
assertions.description: Output includes actionable guidance for when to choose each tool
assertions.criteria: The output includes recommendations or a decision framework explaining when Temporal fits better and when BullMQ fits better.

assertions.name: mentions-parallel-or-lanes
assertions.description: Output signals that parallel subagent lanes were used

evals.prompt: Read the pi-9router-ext README at https://github.com/irfansofyana/pi-9router-ext and summarize the web search/fetch capabilities. Verify any setup steps against current package information if possible.
evals.expected_output: URL extraction lane plus verification lane summarizing 9router web tools, setup commands, and gaps with citations.

assertions.name: has-inline-citations
assertions.description: Output contains inline source citations in (source: URL) format

assertions.name: covers-web-tools
assertions.description: Output names the 9router web search/fetch tools or endpoints

assertions.name: covers-setup
assertions.criteria: The output mentions installing pi-9router-ext and configuring or verifying 9router, such as pi install npm:pi-9router-ext, /9router-config, /9router-status, or related environment variables.

assertions.name: has-url-and-verification-lanes
assertions.description: Output shows URL extraction plus a verification/checking lane or equivalent coverage
assertions.criteria: The output indicates the provided URL was fetched/extracted and at least one additional source or current package information was checked, or explains why verification could not be completed.
